description: Merging configuration for one domain across multiple documents makes every contributed limit resolvable: a value-qualified limit from the last document, a key-only default from a middle document, and a single-document merge that still resolves its only limit.

configs.name: a.yaml
configs.content:
domain: d
descriptors:
  - key: k1
    value: v1
    rate_limit:
      unit: minute
      requests_per_unit: 10

configs.name: b.yaml
configs.content:
domain: d
descriptors:
  - key: k2
    rate_limit:
      unit: hour
      requests_per_unit: 20

configs.name: c.yaml
configs.content:
domain: d
descriptors:
  - key: k3
    value: v3
    rate_limit:
      unit: day
      requests_per_unit: 30

cases.expected_output:
matched=true
full_key=d.k3_v3
requests_per_unit=30
unit=DAY
unlimited=false
shadow_mode=false
